news.title: Ballon d’Or Goalkeeper of the Year: All nominees
news.lede: And this year, it brings a new set of nominees with results influenced by not just club football, but also the FIFA World Cup 2026. The World Cup had a massive impact on who ended up being nominated and nowhere is this more apparent than with the Yashin Trophy. The Yashin Trophy, named after the goalkeeping legend Lev Yashin, will be awarded to one goalkeeper each in the men’s and women’s categories. This year, ten nominees for men’s and five nominees for women’s have been selected.

news.title: Football: Soccer-Amrabat quits Morocco ahead of Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers
news.lede: Sept 8 (Reuters) - Midfielder Sofyan ⁠Amrabat has made himself unavailable for Morocco ahead of the start ⁠of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers this month, ‌saying he will not play under current coach Mohamed Ouahbi but has not retired from international football. Amrabat would not reveal his reasons for the decision but had limited game-time ​at the recent World Cup in the ⁠United States, Canada and Mexico, ⁠where he started one of his side’s six games as they lost to ⁠France ‌in the quarter-finals. The emergence of Manchester City midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi has limited his game time. "This has been a very difficult ⁠decision, but I do not feel able to continue ​representing the national ‌team under the current head coach," Amrabat said in an Instagram ⁠post.

news.title: Spain Dismisses Ceuta Crisis Impact on 2030 World Cup Final Debate
news.lede: Rabat – Spain’s Minister for Education, Vocational Training and Sport, Milagros Tolón, has rejected suggestions that the migration crisis in Ceuta could affect the decision over the venue of the 2030 FIFA World Cup final. Speaking to Spanish public broadcaster TVE, Tolón said she does not believe the situation in Ceuta will influence FIFA’s decision on where to stage the tournament’s showpiece match. “Who decides is FIFA,” Tolón said, stressing that the Spanish Ministry of Sport is working with all parties involved in the 2030 World Cup to deliver what she described as the best edition of the tournament. She also pointed to Spain’s football success and sporting infrastructure as reasons for her confidence in the country’s chances.

news.title: World Cup final scorer Torres leads Ballon d'Or nominees
news.lede: PARIS (FRANCE) - Ferran Torres, whose goal against Argentina won the World Cup for Spain in July, leads a 30-man list for the men's Ballon d'Or revealed on Tuesday. The 26-year-old who has since joined Paris Saint-Germain is one of six Spanish World Cup winners on the list, alongside 2024 laureate Rodri and last year's runner-up Lamine Yamal. In the women's section, three-time winner Aitana Bonmati did not make the shortlist after breaking her leg midway through the season, but her former Barcelona team-mate Alexia Putellas, the winner in 2021 and 2022 and now a London City Lionesses player, is there. Torres also won La Liga with Barcelona in May but is now teaming up with last year's Ballon d'Or winner Ousmane Dembele at PSG.

news.title: Ballon d'Or 2026 nominees: Harry Kane, Jude Bellingham and Declan Rice nominated
news.lede: Harry Kane scored 73 goals last season for club and country. Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane is one of three England players nominated for the 2026 Ballon d'Or. Real Madrid's Jude Bellingham and Arsenal's Declan Rice join Kane, the favourite for the award, on the 30-player shortlist. Inter Miami forward Lionel Messi, who is looking to win his ninth Ballon d'Or, has been nominated.

news.title: European football leagues’ body accuses FIFA of ’abusive conduct’ over women’s calendar

REUTERS/Arnd Wiegmann/File Photo European Leagues has expanded its complaint to the European Commission, accusing FIFA of prioritising its own competitions and commercial interests at the expense of women’s football, player welfare and domestic leagues. NYON A group representing many of Europe’s major football leagues has accused FIFA of “abusive conduct” in how it runs the international calendar for women’s competitions after filing an expanded complaint to the European Commission.

news.title: Rene Meulensteen says Man Utd should have signed Spain's World Cup hero
news.lede: Manchester United should have explored a transfer move for Unai Simon, says Rene Meulensteen (Picture: No Tippy Tappy Football) Former Manchester United coach Rene Meulensteen says the club should have made a move for Athletic Bilbao and Spain goalkeeper Unai Simon in the summer transfer window. The Red Devils replaced the error-prone Andre Onana by signing Senne Lammens from Royal Antwerp in a deal worth in the region of £18million last summer. The 24-year-old would go on to enjoy a promising debut season at Old Trafford, winning United fans over with a series of impressive performances across his opening 33 appearances. However, it has proven a tricky start to the new campaign for Lammens, with Michael Carrick’s side picking up just four points from their first three matches in the Premier League and conceding six goals in the process.

news.title: Barca star Yamal says will not beg for Ballon d'Or
news.lede: Barcelona star Lamine Yamal said Tuesday he will not beg for the Ballon d'Or trophy after winning the World Cup with Spain and La Liga with the Catalan giants. On Monday Real Madrid star Kylian Mbappe made his case to win the trophy, highlighting his World Cup Golden Boot win, which also saw him become the competition's all-time top goalscorer. Yamal, 19, thought he had played very well while winning trophies for club and country but said he was happy to let others decide whether he deserved the prize. The teenager, Mbappe, Harry Kane, Ousmane Dembele and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia are the main candidates to win the award at the ceremony in London on 26 October.
